title: Keep custody-audit Git queries within the sixty-second minimum
outcome: New task-sync custody audit paths honor the shared minimum abort allowance and bounded warning policy without changing custody or recovery semantics.
acceptance: Every new custody-audit Git query reachable through task-sync custody-audit, including audit.rs, audit/data.rs and audit/orphan.rs, uses an allowance of at least sixty seconds for a fresh operation, preserves any already-admitted absolute remaining deadline, and retains the bounded non-interrupting ten-second warning.

Behavioral regression evidence exercises the affected audit-query path beyond the old thirty-second boundary and verifies the applicable deadline plus unchanged custody refusal, rollback and exact retry behavior; the focused checks and independent acceptance evaluation pass on the delivered clean candidate.
